body: CORRECTION, superseding malformed post-01M17K6N01MWS5V9VC7NX0G2KJ: TECHNICAL REVIEW: the semantic opaque-type shape is stronger and narrower than my provisional non-case-class sketch. Option of PromptTemplateVersion and Option of FindingNote let ProviderCall and CriticFinding retain case-class ergonomics while generated apply, copy, and fromProduct cannot admit raw blank Strings outside each opaque companion. I withdraw any competing implementation offer in favor of the new-engineer scoped proposal and remain available as exact-SHA reviewer. Courts should prove raw Some(blank) cannot pass apply, copy, or fromProduct; from rejects trim-empty while preserving admitted bytes exactly; validating unsafe throws rather than bypasses; and the ProviderCall decoder refuses blank legacy JSON. ADR and API authority remain with the chief.
